_comment: Side quest idea bank (§ gamification brainstorm). Each entry is a rotating prompt shown on the hub as a 'side quest' — the app never picks the contact for you, you self-select who fits the framing. Add/edit entries freely; 'id' must stay stable once shipped since it's referenced by history rows.

prompts.title: Two degrees apart
prompts.prompt: Message two people in your life who've never met each other.

prompts.title: The opposite number
prompts.prompt: Reach out to the person who's least like you — different stage of life, different vibe, whatever "opposite" means to you.

prompts.title: Cross the aisle
prompts.prompt: Check in on someone you don't always see eye to eye with.

prompts.title: Forward the feeling
prompts.prompt: Send someone a reel, song, or article that reminded you of them today.

prompts.title: Say it, don't type it
prompts.prompt: Send a voice note instead of a text.

prompts.title: Dig one up
prompts.prompt: Send someone an old photo they're in.

prompts.title: Old job, new hello
prompts.prompt: Message someone from a job or school you've left behind.

prompts.title: The one who moved
prompts.prompt: Reach out to someone who moved away and you never adjusted your rhythm with.

prompts.title: Same day, different year
prompts.prompt: Message someone around the anniversary of how you met or a memory you shared.

prompts.title: Even the score
prompts.prompt: Message someone who's messaged you first the last few times.

prompts.title: Break the ice
prompts.prompt: Be the one to speak up first after a long mutual silence.

prompts.title: No reason needed
prompts.prompt: Reach out to someone specifically because you know they're going through something, not because it's "their turn."

prompts.title: Good news call
prompts.prompt: Message whoever you'd tell first if something amazing happened today.

prompts.title: Comic relief
prompts.prompt: Message the person who always makes you laugh, just because.

prompts.title: Quiet supporter
prompts.prompt: Reach out to someone who never asks for anything but always shows up.

prompts.title: Different generations
prompts.prompt: Message someone a decade or more older or younger than you.

prompts.title: The introvert and the extrovert
prompts.prompt: Reach out to someone whose social energy is the total opposite of yours.

prompts.title: Long distance, short message
prompts.prompt: Message the person who lives farthest away from you right now.

prompts.title: Different worlds
prompts.prompt: Check in with someone whose day-to-day life looks nothing like yours.

prompts.title: The quiet one
prompts.prompt: Message the person in a group chat who talks the least.

prompts.title: New vs. old
prompts.prompt: Reach out to someone you met this year, then someone you've known for over a decade.

prompts.title: Unlikely pair
prompts.prompt: Message two people who'd probably never be friends with each other.

prompts.title: The skeptic
prompts.prompt: Check in with someone who always challenges your opinions.

prompts.title: Opposite hours
prompts.prompt: Message someone whose schedule is the reverse of yours — night owl or early bird.

prompts.title: Different chapter, same story
prompts.prompt: Reach out to someone going through a life stage you've already been through.

prompts.title: Just a photo
prompts.prompt: Send a photo with no caption — let it speak for itself.

prompts.title: Three words
prompts.prompt: Send someone a message that's exactly three words long.

prompts.title: The meme that gets it
prompts.prompt: Send a meme that perfectly describes an inside joke between you two.

prompts.title: Handwritten feel
prompts.prompt: Write a message like you're writing a postcard, not a text.

prompts.title: Ask, don't tell
prompts.prompt: Send someone a genuine question instead of a statement.

prompts.title: The compliment drop
prompts.prompt: Send a specific, unprompted compliment.

prompts.title: Screenshot and send
prompts.prompt: Share a screenshot of something that made you think of them.

prompts.title: One emoji only
prompts.prompt: Send a single emoji that captures how you're feeling about them today.

prompts.title: The playlist share
prompts.prompt: Send a song you think they'd like right now.

prompts.title: Recreate a memory
prompts.prompt: Send something — a photo, song, or quote — that recreates a specific memory you share.

prompts.title: The roommate reunion
prompts.prompt: Message an old roommate you haven't talked to in a while.

prompts.title: Childhood callback
prompts.prompt: Reach out to a friend from childhood you've lost touch with.

prompts.title: The mentor check-in
prompts.prompt: Message someone who taught or mentored you once.

prompts.title: Old flame, new friendship
prompts.prompt: Check in with an ex on purely friendly terms, if that bridge is still standing.

prompts.title: The team you left
prompts.prompt: Message someone from a team or project you're no longer part of.

prompts.title: Before they were somebody
prompts.prompt: Reach out to someone you knew before they became who they are now.

prompts.title: The neighbor you used to have
prompts.prompt: Message someone who used to live near you.

prompts.title: Class of yesteryear
prompts.prompt: Reach out to an old classmate you haven't spoken to since graduation.

prompts.title: The group that dissolved
prompts.prompt: Message someone from a friend group that isn't really a group anymore.

prompts.title: Where are they now
prompts.prompt: Reach out to someone you've wondered about but never actually messaged.

prompts.title: The always-there friend
prompts.prompt: Message the person who always shows up for you, even when you don't ask.

prompts.title: Return the favor
prompts.prompt: Reach out to someone who helped you out and you never properly thanked.

prompts.title: The unanswered text
prompts.prompt: Reply to that one message you've been meaning to respond to for too long.

prompts.title: Check on the checker-inner
prompts.prompt: Message the person who always checks in on you — ask how they're doing for once.

prompts.title: The one who remembers
prompts.prompt: Reach out to someone who always remembers the small details about your life.

prompts.title: Uneven ledger
prompts.prompt: Message someone you feel like you owe a real conversation to.

prompts.title: Silent supporter
prompts.prompt: Reach out to someone who's liked or reacted to your stuff but you never message back.

prompts.title: The favor bank
prompts.prompt: Message someone you'd call if you needed a favor — check in before you need one.

prompts.title: Be the effort
prompts.prompt: Reach out to someone you know puts more effort into the friendship than you do.

prompts.title: The waiting game
prompts.prompt: Message someone you've been "meaning to text back" for over a week.

prompts.title: The hype person
prompts.prompt: Message whoever always hypes you up before something big.

prompts.title: Bad day translator
prompts.prompt: Reach out to the person you'd vent to on a genuinely bad day.

prompts.title: The realist
prompts.prompt: Message the friend who always gives it to you straight.

prompts.title: Proud-of-you person
prompts.prompt: Reach out to someone who'd be proud of something you did recently, even if it was small.

prompts.title: The nostalgia buddy
prompts.prompt: Message the person who shares your favorite old memories.

prompts.title: Emergency contact energy
prompts.prompt: Reach out to whoever you'd actually call in an emergency.

prompts.title: The dreamer
prompts.prompt: Message someone who always encourages your big ideas.

prompts.title: Low-key check-in
prompts.prompt: Reach out to someone who never makes a big deal out of anything, just because.

prompts.title: The celebration text
prompts.prompt: Message whoever you'd tell about a small personal win.

prompts.title: Comfort zone
prompts.prompt: Reach out to the person who makes you feel instantly at ease, no matter how long it's been.
